gap_closure.by_owner_order: Owner ruled the missing frames necessary (2026-10-27); produced the same day.
gap_closure.history: At the 2026-10-27 design lock the walk generation had produced the four direction idles and left/right strides only; walk_down_step / walk_up_step did not exist, the partial atlas carried one EMPTY cell (row 2, col 3) for both, and the gap was recorded here as missing, not fabricated. Both frames were then generated (text-only prompts, no character name, casual outfit, no baked shadows; generation originals kept as media-generation-falk-walk-down-step-gen-* / media-generation-falk-walk-up-step-gen-*), pixel-normalised to the walk sheet's sprite scale, and added as a fifth row in falk-walk-sheet-COMPLETE-2026-10-27.webp (original sheet region pixel-identical). The complete atlas fills all 16 cells; the step row was re-ordered to mirror the idle row (down/up/left/right), moving walk_left_step / walk_right_step cells without changing their pixels. walk_right_step2 remains in the source walk sheet but is no longer atlased - the 16-cell atlas has no room for a duplicate-direction frame once all four directional steps are present.
gap_closure.identity_check: PASS - eye-checked against the locked model sheet and the walk sheet idles at production scale: same face (simple sprite face, dark vertical eyes), warm medium-tan skin, tall swept-up golden-blond spiky hair, goggles on forehead (front frame) / goggle strap across the back of the head (back frame), teal scarf knot, cream-and-teal casual flight jacket, belt pouch, slate trousers, brown boots; mid-stride poses read clearly (down: one boot planted, one trailing; up: trailing boot sole showing). Recorded nuance: the new frames' proportions run slightly less chibi than the sheet idles (head share ~40% vs ~49%) - same character, not a different person; flagged here per the drift rule, not a canon change.

form_split.ruling: Owner reviewed the completed walk sheet and ruled its first figures are the CHIBI form. The forms are separated and completed: the atlas set is now THREE atlases. The mixed atlas above (falk-atlas-64x64-COMPLETE-2026-10-27.png) is retained unchanged as the historical mixed set; the two new atlases below are form-pure.
form_split.measurement_method: Every placed cell was classified BY EYE against the locked model sheet (full-size) and the pixel walk idles (chibi), backed by a measured head share = (top of figure to neck/scarf line) / figure height. Two scans were used: (a) scarf-row scan - first row where the bright teal scarf/collar colour reaches >=4% of figure width (valid for all back views, the pixel sprites, and the earlier illustrated art); (b) hair/skin row-width scan - head bottom = first sustained row where hair+skin width falls below 22% of its maximum (used for the new chibi illustrations and the dojo plate, whose large blue irises trip the teal scan). Where both scans are valid they agree within ~2 points (world front 27.5/29.0; side steps 25.0/26.3). battle_front_casual was measured by located points on the source plate (hair top y12, chin y245, boot bottom y991 on a 1000 scale = 23.8%). Measured form bands: FULL-SIZE 18-28%, CHIBI 39-56% - no overlap.
form_split.classification_of_existing_material: The COMPLETE walk sheet's pixel rows measure CHIBI (idles 39.0-44.5% head share) - the owner's ruling confirmed by measurement. Its closing-row anime down/up step frames measure FULL-SIZE-leaning (28.4% / 26.7%) and are placed in the full-size set. The world views, model sheet, battle fronts, portrait and dojo plate are FULL-SIZE.
